Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of V.
We generated $8.6 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $7.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2019.
Our gross margin expanded by 73 basis points to 60.6%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 13% to 25% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 73 basis points to 60.6%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 73 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
